title: Curating clips: play and rate each auto clip on a sample; filter and sort the Clips list
description: Sample page: every clip row (auto markup included) gets a play button and inline stars; auto markup open by default, grouped by type. Clips list: filter by stars (unrated / at least N), date added, type (loop, one-shot, section), origin (auto, mine, others), sample, length; sort by stars, newest, length; per-row play and stars; filters kept in the URL.
